subject: Activation preflight: Portal identity mismatch and MSA revision
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@brightlinemed.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation preflight: vendor identity mismatch + next steps for portal activation

Hi Anna,

Quick preflight as we prepare to activate Brightline in the Coupa/Ariba onboarding flow. Two items popped up during validation that will block activation unless we resolve them:

1) Vendor identity mismatch: your procurement system lists the vendor as "Brightline Medical, Inc." but legal signature on the countersigned MSA is "Brightline Medical Group LLC". Finance will not accept PO routing until legal entity matches the order form and DBA.
2) PO field mapping: the portal requires a four-digit GL code in the PO header (field GL_CODE). Our default PO mapping is sending a six-digit project code and dropping the GL_CODE; Brightline needs GL_CODE present for invoice routing.

Can you confirm which legal entity should go on the order form and whether your procurement system can accept GL_CODE as a separate field? If it helps, I can loop in Legal to propose a narrow MSA edit that allows the billing entity to be a related affiliate.

Plan I propose:
- You confirm legal entity and primary billing address by EOD tomorrow.
- I share a minimal MSA amendment draft if you need to anchor billing to an affiliate.
- Markus will coordinate the field map with our integration engineers once we have the final entity name.

Attachments: I referenced the countersigned MSA and a sample PO we received for field context.

Thanks — want to get you live this week if possible.

Diego Fernandez
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
Diego cell: +1 (415) 555-0121

Attachments: Brightline_MSA_signed.pdf (stated), sample_PO_0527.pdf (stated)

From: Anna Lee <anna.lee@brightlinemed.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@brightlinemed.com>, Brightline IT <itops@brightlinemed.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation preflight: vendor identity mismatch + next steps for portal activation

Diego — thanks for the heads up.

Short answers:
- Legal entity: Our folks qualify services under "Brightline Medical Group LLC" for commercial contracts, but our finance/billing system is still keyed to "Brightline Medical, Inc." — terrible timing, I know.
- GL_CODE: We can add a GL_CODE field on incoming POs; IT tells me it’s a small mapping change on their side but they will only do it if the vendor record and MSA align.

I'll escalate to our Billing manager and Legal. I attached our internal vendor registration extract and the current PO export so you can see the headers.

Can your legal team propose language that allows the invoice to be issued by a related affiliate (so we don't have to re-key our entire vendor master)? If so, we may be able to avoid a full re-registration.

Best,
Anna Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Brightline Medical

Attachments: Brightline_vendor_export_0518.csv, Brightline_PO_export_sample.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Anna Lee <anna.lee@brightlinemed.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation preflight: vendor identity mismatch + next steps for portal activation

Anna / Diego — looping in Legal. I opened the MSA redline and prepared a narrow amendment that addresses affiliate billing and order-form entity mismatch without changing liability sections. Main points:

- New clause (Section 2.4 amendment): "Invoices and purchase orders may name a related entity of Redwood Inference as the billing entity where such entity is an affiliate of Redwood and has provided prior written notice to Customer's billing contact."
- Add an Order Form field prefatory sentence so the PO can specify "Billing Entity" and the MSA references it.

I attached Brightline_MSA_redline_v3.docx — it highlights the minimal additions and a short cover note for countersignature. If that works for you, Anna, we can route via DocuSign.

Next steps suggested:
- Anna: confirm you can accept an affiliate-billing clause; if yes, Legal can sign the amendment and we can proceed with the portal activation immediately after the mapping change.
- Markus: once Anna confirms, please schedule a short mapping handoff with Brightline IT and include expected latency for GL_CODE adoption.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: Brightline_MSA_redline_v3.docx

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@brightlinemed.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation preflight: vendor identity mismatch + next steps for portal activation

Anna — thanks for the quick reply and for sharing the exports. On the ops side, the mapping change to include GL_CODE is straightforward:

- Our integration layer accepts PO headers and maps them to GL_CODE if present. We can add a conditional rule so that if GL_CODE exists we copy it to invoice.routing.gl_code and if absent we fallback to the project_code.
- Estimated work: 2 dev hours + 1 hour testing + scheduling a 30-minute handshake with your IT (we can do it tomorrow afternoon).

If Legal signs the narrow affiliate billing amendment Kimberly proposed, we can:
1) Apply the mapping change same day (post-signature).
2) Update your vendor record to show "Billing entity: Brightline Medical, Inc." with the legal name "Brightline Medical Group LLC" in the vendor notes so finance knows to accept invoices from the affiliate.
3) Run a staged test PO to confirm invoice routing works end-to-end.

Action items summary:
- Anna: confirm affiliate-billing clause acceptance (reply OK) and share preferred IT times for a 30-min call.
- Kimberly: prepare DocuSign envelope if Anna confirms.
- Diego: coordinate activation window and schedule the test PO.

Thanks — will hold a 3pm slot tomorrow if that helps.

Markus Klein
Activation Lead | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0199
